name: code-quality
description: Audit maintainability, runtime scaling, and security with evidence, focused fixes, and estimated effort.

interface.shortDescription: Focused audits for maintainability, runtime scaling, and security.
interface.longDescription: Audit a repository or selected area for maintainability, runtime scaling, or security. Report all supported findings by root cause, ranked by impact, with estimated effort and verified source locations.
defaultPrompt: Run audit-repo for one combined maintainability, runtime scaling, and security report.
Audit runtime scaling, concurrent work, and recovery in this repository.
Audit security risks in this repository, including dependencies and CI.
